# Vendor artwork

- `craigslist.ico`: original favicon downloaded without alteration from
  https://www.craigslist.org/favicon.ico on 2026-10-11, after verifying the
  official homepage references it.

Artwork is served locally, only for matching official listing hostnames.
Other vendors use a neutral store icon and readable name/hostname until their
original artwork is verified. These are source identifiers, not endorsements
or evidence that a listing is current, inspected, or fairly priced.
